title: 聚法法律数据 MCP 配置
description: 请输入聚法智能体数据平台 API Key。凭证仅由 WorkBuddy 保存在本机，并在启动聚法 MCP 时作为环境变量注入；聚法服务端在请求鉴权时会接收该凭证。
description_en: Enter your Jufa Agent Data Platform API Key. WorkBuddy stores it only on this device and injects it as an environment variable when starting the Jufa MCP process; Jufa receives it for request authentication.

fields.label: 聚法 API Key
fields.placeholder: 登录聚法智能体数据平台 → 个人中心 → API Key
fields.placeholder_en: Sign in to Jufa Agent Data Platform → Profile → API Key
fields.description: 用于访问聚法法律数据服务；失效或疑似泄露时请在聚法平台重新生成。
fields.description_en: Used to access Jufa legal data services. Regenerate it on Jufa if it expires or may have been exposed.
